title: Build it right
instructions: Tap the tiles in order to build each formula and team rule. Tap a placed tile to send it back. One tile in every bank does not belong.

items.hint: ROAS stands for *return on ad spend* — the denominator is in the name.
items.explanation: ROAS = revenue ÷ ad spend. A ROAS of 3.4× means every dollar of spend brought back $3.40 in revenue. It ignores margin, so read it next to CPA.

items.hint: CPA is what *one result* cost, so divide by the number of results.
items.explanation: CPA = spend ÷ conversions. Northwind Outdoor's March CPA of $21.40 means each sale or sign-up cost just over twenty dollars to win.

items.prompt: Put Brightline's first rule of every kickoff in order.
items.hint: The sentence starts with a verb and ends with what you build.
items.explanation: A confirmed brief — objective, audience, budget and the KPI that defines success — stops the team from building the wrong campaign beautifully.

items.prompt: Complete the account-team rule for when something goes wrong.
items.hint: Timing first, then what you walk in with.
items.explanation: Clients forgive problems; they rarely forgive surprises. Raising an issue early, with a fix already sketched, keeps the conversation about solutions instead of blame.

feedback.complete: Two formulas and two habits every Brightline account manager uses before lunch on a Monday.
